ICS 65.100.30FAD 01Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for nickel chloride hexahydrate, pesticidal grade.2. REFERENCESThe standards, given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.IS 1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water - Specification (third revision)IS 8190 (Part 1) : 1988 Requirements for packing of pesticides: Part 1 Solid pesticides (second revision)IS 10946 : 1996 Methods of sampling for technical grade pesticides
